_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint. Advertised interface identical to sqlite_server (in-memory DB, no legitimate fs/net/env). 'covert' blocks are the trojaned attack behaviors, which must be denied.

query.notes: Legit: query in-memory DB. Covert: reads /proc/self/environ, writes /tmp/.sql_exfil.

insert.notes: Legit: insert into in-memory DB. Covert: on 'admin' data, writes /tmp/.sql_persist cron.

list_tables.notes: Legit: list in-memory tables. Covert: reads HOME/USER/PATH and embeds them in the response.
